thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: runtime canary error rate and latency spike detected after deploy (canary rollout: 2026-03-15-rc3). Metric: canary-p50 +45%, canary-error-rate 6.3%. Paging @maria (oncall).
maria: I'm on it, looking at dashboards now. which route is failing?
samira: canary traffic for /v1/generate-prefetch is showing high kernel-fallbacks and large batch queues. tail latency up to 8s on some requests.
ajay: noticing high prefetch fanout queue depth in worker-0 across the canary slice. suspects: new batching change (fanout batching) in rc3.
kevin: also seeing an uptick in kernel fallback logs - many requests falling back to CPU path which is killing throughput.
maria: ok primary mitigations: 1) kill the new feature flag for prefetch fanout, 2) if that doesn't drop error-rate quickly, trigger canary rollback. I'm going to flip the flag now.
ajay: +1 flip the flag. That code path was added in commit 9f3b2a (prefetch_fanout_v2).
maria: /api/feature-toggle set prefetch_fanout_v2 false --scope=canary
deploy-bot: feature-toggle: prefetch_fanout_v2 set to off for canary (by maria).
samira: metrics starting to move: p50 trending down, kernel-fallbacks halved. error-rate dropping from 6.3% -> 2.1%.
cory: pasting snippet from runtime logs showing fallback churn:
```
[2026-03-15T09:13:41Z] worker-0: ATTENTION kernel_exec failed - fallback=true - err=cuLaunchKernel: out_of_memory
[2026-03-15T09:13:41Z] worker-0: batch_size=48 prefetch_slots=16 -> queue_len=124
[2026-03-15T09:13:42Z] worker-0: kv_cache hit=0 miss=124 -> cold-starts
```
kevin: looks like the fanout change increased per-request GPU memory pressure, causing launches to fail and runtime to fall back to CPU path. that explains latency + throughput drop.
liz-product: any customer impact? we should surface to customer success if enterprise traffic hit SLOs.
product-ops: early count: 4 enterprise customers saw >25% request failures for ~4 minutes during canary window; internal tracker opened: INC-2445.
maria: good catch. severity P1 for canary, limited to canary users but some production customers routed to canary variants. continuing mitigation: start rollback to previous canary image and scale down canary slice until rollback completes.
maria: /deploy rollback canary-2026-03-15-rc2 --slice canary
deploy-bot: rollback initiated for canary-2026-03-15-rc3 -> canary-2026-03-15-rc2 (started by maria). estimated completion 90s per slice.
ajay: while rollback runs, recommend blocking new canary rollouts and adding a preflight memory-pressure test to CI.
samira: also enabling temporary increased batching timeouts to flush queues: conf: runtime.batch.max_wait_ms=120 -> 200.
cory: after rollback completes, kernel fallback events drop to baseline and throughput recovers. observed canary error-rate down to 0.6% and p95 back to normal.
kevin: note: there are ~120 requests stuck in retry/backoff causing some user-facing 5xx spikes even after rollback; running a drain to flush backlog.
maria: running manual drain on worker-0: /runtime/worker drain worker-0 --timeout 30s
deploy-bot: drain started. backlog drained.
product-ops: notifying CS and impacted customers: sending templated message, offering incident update and ETA.
liz-product: draft message: "We've identified a regression in a canary rollout that impacted a small number of requests. We've rolled back the canary and disabled the new prefetch fanout flag. We're monitoring and will follow up with root cause and mitigations."
maria: good. postmortem action items for follow-up: - revert commit 9f3b2a from canary until pre-deploy memory tests exist - add synthetic load test for prefetch fanout path - add alert for kernel-fallback rate >1% - update rollout docs to require health-check window of 10m with memory metrics - add feature-flag kill-switch runbook and test it
ajay: I'll own the pre-deploy test and the rollout doc updates. samira will look at memory optimizations.
samira: logging TODO: tag fallback logs with deploy id so we can map to rollout.
cory: correlating logs with kv_cache/memory stats helped here. we should surface those metrics to canary dashboards by default.
kevin: final numbers to include in pagerdoc: peak canary-error-rate 6.3%, peak p50 increase +45%, affected enterprise customers 4 listed, mitigation time from alert -> rollback ~5m, total impact window ~7m.
maria: thanks everyone. incident status: mitigated, rollback complete, monitoring continuing for 30m. filing INC-2445 and assigning postmortem owners. :thumbsup:
product-ops: noted. assigning postmortem to ajay/samira. will schedule follow-up review tomorrow.
incident-bot: incident INC-2445 created and assigned to ajay, samira (severity P1).
